objective_boundary.research_question: 在固定的代表性场内基金集合中，以公开页面显示累计净值作为未经独立验证的经济回报代理时，一条固定月度绝对动量规则是否会被严格历史否决线证伪。

pre_observation_disclosure.description: Before this rule was written, the research session used akshare.fund_etf_fund_info_em to check Eastmoney historical-NAV field availability and viewed sample/history responses for at least some relevant codes. Those responses were not retained as R5 source files and no R5 rule calculation was run at that time.
pre_observation_disclosure.effect: This is not a clean pre-registration before any related historical response was seen. Positive outputs cannot be used as independent out-of-sample or strategy evidence; negative outputs remain exploratory only.
pre_observation_disclosure.legacy_filename_boundary: The filename retains predeclared for continuity only and must not be interpreted as a clean preregistration claim.

fixed_implementation_universe.selection_basis: Pre-existing R0 official product dossiers, mapped mechanically into one equity, one government-bond, one gold and one fallback money-market sleeve; no post-rule R5 price, NAV, scale, turnover, manager, theme or performance data may change this mapping.

rule.signal_timing: last common observation of calendar month
rule.equity_signal_sleeve_convention: fixed_base_buy_and_hold_equal_weighted_level; selected-equity targets reset to 50/50 only at strategy rebalances
rule.target_weight_rule: equal weight across all eligible sleeves; if none is eligible, 100% fallback_money_market

evaluation.terminal_calendar_year_rule: terminal calendar year is eligible only when the final common observation is on calendar December 31
evaluation.terminal_rolling_month_rule: terminal month is eligible only when the final common observation is on its calendar month end

source_route.provider: Eastmoney public fund-history page/API via direct HTTPS request
source_route.raw_archive_requirement: Store every response body, retrieval timestamp, request parameters and SHA-256 before derived calculation.

rule.observation_panel: intersection of all five fund date series after parsing; all cumulative NAV values must be positive and dates unique
rule.signal_timing: last common observation of calendar month
rule.equity_sleeve_value: equal-weighted normalized cumulative NAV of 510300 and 510880
rule.equity_signal_sleeve_convention: fixed_base_buy_and_hold_equal_weighted_level; selected-equity targets reset to 50/50 only at strategy rebalances
rule.target_weight_rule: equal weight across all eligible sleeves; if none is eligible, 100% fallback_money_market

accounting.cost_boundary: An illustrative load only; not an assertion of broker fees, tax, bid/ask, impact, fills, settlement or capacity.

evaluation.rolling_five_year_metric: annualized net unitized change over every monthly endpoint with 1260 complete common-observation intervals
evaluation.terminal_calendar_year_rule: terminal calendar year is eligible only when the final common observation is on calendar December 31
evaluation.terminal_rolling_month_rule: terminal month is eligible only when the final common observation is on its calendar month end
not_falsified_requirements: no input, timing or accounting failure

material_differences: public displayed accumulated-NAV proxy rather than public close
absolute sleeve momentum rather than relative top-N selection
single fixed rule rather than variant grid
equity products locked inside one sleeve
money-market ETF only as no-eligible-sleeve fallback

hard_limitations: Public, retrospectively captured rows do not establish original-date availability, revisions, field semantics or data rights.
Displayed accumulated NAV is not an executable exchange-market price and does not establish investor net return.
No market-price/NAV/IOPV, fund-event, halt, limit, lot, bid-ask, fill, fee, tax, settlement or suitability model is present.
The five-code group is not U0, historical population, a decision universe or a recommendation list.
A hurdle result cannot close UR01--UR05 or establish individual action feasibility.

post_result_audit_amendment.reason: Independent audit found that the implementation previously validated only the artifact identifier rather than the fixed universe, rule, timing, accounting and evaluation fields.
post_result_audit_amendment.scope: Adds a machine-checkable duplicate of already-stated parameters plus explicit conservative terminal-period eligibility rules. It adds no universe, threshold, source or current-result variant; the archived terminal date is 2026-08-14, so the explicit rule leaves it incomplete as before.
post_result_audit_amendment.integrity_boundary: This amendment occurs after observation, does not repair the prior-observation issue and cannot create a preregistration or out-of-sample claim.

post_result_b_level_clarification.reason: The refreshed independent audit requested an explicit distinction between the equity signal's fixed-base buy-and-hold convention and the strategy's 50/50 reset target at a selected-sleeve rebalance.
post_result_b_level_clarification.scope: Documents the calculation already implemented, adds a fail-closed synthetic self-test, and does not change the current raw inputs, rule outcome, universe, threshold, timing, accounting or result.
post_result_b_level_clarification.integrity_boundary: This post-result clarification cannot create a preregistration, out-of-sample, investor-return or action claim.

allowed_conclusion: A single public-data proxy hypothesis is or is not falsified under its own stated arithmetic; no other conclusion is allowed.
